title: Lissity on the union of stratum interiors
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $E$ be an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and let $T$ be a finite locally closed constructible stratification [def-constructible-stratification]. Suppose the set inverse image of the underlying set sheaf of $E$ to every stratum is finite locally constant [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Put $W=\bigcup_i\operatorname{int}_Z(T_i)$. The underlying set sheaf of the abelian inverse image of $E$ to $W$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is finite locally constant.

source.place: ## Proof, first three paragraphs (closedness, reduction, generic lisse source)

proof.text: For each interior V_i form P_i=V_i times_Z T.domain i. The first projection is a surjective immersion by base change and image containment. An immersion with full image is closed (factor it as a closed immersion into an open subscheme; that open must be the whole target). It is therefore a universal homeomorphism.

Convert the lisse set restriction on T.domain i to the underlying abelian restriction by the inverse-image/forget comparison. Pull back along the second projection and identify the two composite inverse images. The site equivalence along the first projection transports etale covers and constant objects; it descends the trivialization to V_i. Geometric points lift along the surjective closed immersion and inverse-image stalks identify the finite stalks. This proves lissity on each V_i without requiring a scheme factorization V_i to T.domain i.

The V_i cover W. Compose the trivializing etale covers of their restrictions with this open cover to obtain a trivializing etale cover of W. Lift each geometric point of W to one V_i; its stalk is the finite stalk there. For empty W use the empty cover and the vacuous stalk condition.

theorem lisse_on_stratum_interiors
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (E : Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (T : Stratification Z)
    (hT : ∀ i : Fin T.n, IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((etaleSetPullback (T.immersion i)).obj
        ((sheafCompose Z.smallEtaleTopology
          (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj E))) :
    IsLisseEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose T.interiorUnion.toScheme.smallEtaleTopology
        (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} T.interiorUnion.ι).obj E))
